article.headline: Houston's 16 points help Washington State down Hawaii 79-63
article.description: — Lazerek Houston scored 16 points as Washington State beat Hawaii 79-63 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Houston's 16 points help Washington State down Hawaii 79-63

categories.description: Washington State Cougars @ Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors

event.description: Washington State Cougars @ Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors

keywords: Washington State Cougars @ Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors
article.story: EVERETT, Wash. -- — Lazerek Houston scored 16 points as Washington State beat Hawaii 79-63 on Wednesday. Houston added 11 rebounds, nine assists, and four steals for the Cougars (2-3). Ronnie Harrison Jr. scored 15 points while shooting 5 of 10 from the field and 5 for 6 from the line. Tyler Kropp shot 5 of 9 from the field and 3 for 3 from the line to finish with 13 points. Chance Trujillo finished with 17 points for the Rainbow Warriors (3-2). Hawaii also got 11 points from Tanner Cuff. Isaiah Kerr finished with 11 points. Washington State took the lead for good with 3:01 remaining in the first half. The Cougars led 30-26 at halftime. Washington State pulled away with a 9-0 run in the second half to extend a four-point lead to 13 points. Up next Up next for Washington State is a Saturday matchup with Duke, and Hawaii hosts Incarnate Word on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
